full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil painting fills the frame with a close-up face beneath a wide blue hat, set against densely worked crimson, violet, and black paint. The brim cuts diagonally across the upper left and throws the left side of the face into deep shadow. One eye remains partly hidden beneath it, while the other large dark eye sits near the upper center, ringed with blue, purple, and pale cream strokes. The head turns slightly toward the viewer, with dark hair broken into lively black and cobalt marks along the right edge. Across the cheeks and nose, bright orange, hot pink, turquoise, cream, and ruby patches replace natural smooth skin tones with vigorous blocks of color. The mouth is dark red and slightly open, meeting a pale finger raised near the lips. The hand enters from the lower left and runs diagonally upward, its shape built from thick white, coral, blue, and gray paint rather than precise anatomical lines. At the lower right, a white collar and a dark blue-black knot or lapel suggest formal clothing before they are cropped by the frame. Behind the shadowed cheek at the left, a small yellow brushmark resembles lettering, but it is not clearly readable as text. The surface is visibly tactile, with dragged pigment, abrupt palette-knife-like edges, and short fractured strokes laid over earlier color. Hard blue and orange accents jump forward from violet-black recesses, while the cream face and collar keep the center luminous. Light seems frontal and slightly above, concentrated on the right side of the face and the raised hand, though the hat maintains a strong dark wedge. The overall composition is a tight, energetic arrangement of facial planes and diagonal gestures, using saturated complementary color and broken paint to give the image its theatrical intensity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现性油画让一张戴宽檐蓝帽的脸充满画面，背后是密集涂抹的绯红、紫和黑色颜料。帽檐斜切左上方，让脸的左侧陷入深影。一只眼睛被帽影局部遮住，另一只大而深的眼睛靠近上方中央，周围环绕蓝、紫和浅奶油色笔触。头部略向观者转来，深发在右边缘被活泼的黑色与钴蓝痕迹打碎。脸颊和鼻梁上，亮橘、艳粉、青绿、奶油与红宝石色块代替平滑的自然肤色，呈现充满动势的色彩块面。嘴呈深红色，微微张开，与抬到唇边的浅色手指相接。手从左下进入，斜向上延伸，形状由厚实的白、珊瑚、蓝和灰色颜料构成，而非准确的解剖线条。右下方，白领口与一处深蓝黑结饰或翻领暗示正式衣着，随后被画边裁去。左侧阴影脸颊后方有一小道黄色笔痕近似字迹，却无法清楚读成文字。表面触感明显，有拖曳的颜料、调色刀般突变的边和叠在旧色上的短碎笔触。硬朗蓝橘色强调从紫黑凹处跳出，奶油色脸部与领口使中央保持发亮。光似乎来自正前稍上方，集中在脸的右侧和抬起的手，帽子仍留下强烈深色楔形。整体构图由脸部色面和斜向手势紧密而有力地组成，通过饱和互补色及断裂颜料赋予图像舞台般的强度。
style_prompt_en: This expressionist oil-paint style uses thick, fractured patches of saturated color instead of continuous tonal blending. Cobalt and turquoise strike against orange, crimson, magenta, and violet, while cream highlights and nearly black recesses supply a strong value framework. Broad diagonal masses establish the composition, and small sharp strokes flick across their surfaces to keep the color active. Edges alternate between abrupt, palette-knife-like breaks and passages that disappear beneath overlapping pigment. Paint looks dragged, built up, and occasionally scraped, giving every color area physical weight. Concentrated frontal light makes a few pale planes flare, while adjacent dark wedges heighten theatrical contrast. The image feels close, exuberant, and charged with rhythmic brush movement.
style_prompt_zh: 这种表现性油画风格以厚实、断裂的饱和色块代替连续的明暗调和。钴蓝与青绿撞上橘色、绯红、洋红和紫色，奶油色高光及近黑凹处则提供强烈明度框架。宽阔斜向色块建立构图，小而锋利的笔触横扫其表面，使色彩持续活跃。边缘在调色刀般突然断开的部分与被层叠颜料吞没的部分之间交替。颜料看上去被拖曳、堆积，有时还被刮开，让每片色域都具有实体重量。集中的正面光使少数浅色平面猛然发亮，相邻深色楔形加强舞台式反差。画面贴近、奔放，充满有节奏的笔触运动。
theme_en: A vividly painted close-up of a performer in a blue hat
theme_zh: 戴蓝帽表演者的鲜艳近景肖像
name: LeRoy Neiman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
